---
title: "Conferences"
page-layout: full

The ISNPS conference series is the society's central gathering point: a biennial meeting built around plenary talks, invited sessions, contributed talks, posters, and broad exchange across nonparametric statistics.

## Upcoming meetings

::: {.conference-spotlight}
### 8th ISNPS Conference

**Bocconi University, Milan, Italy**\
**12-16 June 2028**

The 2028 meeting was announced during the ISNPS 2026 General Assembly. Antonio Lijoi ([antonio.lijoi@unibocconi.it](mailto:antonio.lijoi@unibocconi.it)) is the ISNPS contact for Milan 2028.

[Contact Antonio Lijoi](mailto:antonio.lijoi@unibocconi.it){.button .button-primary}
:::

::: {.conference-spotlight}
### 9th ISNPS Conference

**Palais des Arts et de la Culture, Tangier, Morocco**\
**24-28 May 2030**

The 2030 meeting was also announced during the ISNPS 2026 General Assembly. Sophie Dabo ([sophie.dabo@univ-lille.fr](mailto:sophie.dabo@univ-lille.fr)) is the ISNPS contact for Tangier 2030.

[Contact Sophie Dabo](mailto:sophie.dabo@univ-lille.fr){.button .button-primary}
:::
